changes.value: validate the job inputs before launch (required columns, file kind) and fail fast with an actionable message

hypothesis: ml.train keeps failing the same way in recent tickets (ml.train::no_error_recorded, ml.train::LogisticRegression does not accept missing values encoded as), so rejecting that input before launch should remove the retry loop without touching the success path.
risk: pre-flight checks add a small fixed cost to every job and may reject inputs the tool would have tolerated
